text:
Maya: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands — quick follow-up thread for links, actions, and a couple clarifications. Please add any missing owners. :raised_hands:

ops-bot: Recording + deck uploaded: https://redwood.example.com/ah/2024-06-recording and https://redwood.example.com/ah/deck-2024-06.pdf :white_check_mark:

Chris: Re: Dedicated GA — plan is still Q3 but we need to lock the exact week. ACTION: Chris -> publish final GA week by EOD Fri (cc @Maya).

Diego: For runtime perf targets, we committed to 95th pct < 120ms for short prompts. We're going to run an extra perf sweep next week to validate across seq lens. ACTION: Diego -> post perf sweep results in #eng-runtime by Thu.

Asha: Quick question on observability retention — any change to default retention for non-enterprise customers? That came up in the Q&A.

Chris: Short answer: no immediate change. We're evaluating a tiered retention add-on (opt-in) and will share pricing next week. ACTION: Chris -> write short FAQ blurb for customer-facing docs.

Lin: Can we get a transcript? Prefer a text dump for product notes.

ops-bot: Transcript generated: https://redwood.example.com/ah/2024-06/transcript.txt

Sam: Hiring note — we expect to open 4 backend infra roles next month; managers will prioritize interviews from internal referrals first.

Maya: Thanks Sam. Also: reminder to flag any cross-team blockers here. If you need assistance getting approvals, ping me directly.

Diego: Small clarification on rollout policy — the canary rollout for the new batching optimizer will run against 10% of traffic for 72h, then 50% for 24h if no regressions. If regression, automatic rollback to previous model.

Asha: For Private deployments: timeline? We got a few customers asking about air-gapped release cadence.

Chris: Private (VPC) GA timeline target: late Q3. On-prem (air-gapped) is more involved; target is early Q4 but depends on partner packaging. ACTION: Chris -> put final dates + dependencies in roadmap doc by Tue.

Lin: Who owns follow-ups for the SLO dashboard improvements? I can take the spec but need an eng owner for the backend work.

Diego: I'll own the backend prototypes. ACTION: Diego -> drop prototype link in #eng-platform by Mon. Lin -> spec to share today so I can pair.

Maya: One more ask from leadership: capture three measurable success metrics for Dedicated GA (latency SLO, cost per 1k tokens, and adoption threshold). Please add to the GA checklist.

Chris: Noted. ACTION: Chris -> add metrics to GA checklist and share checklist in /docs/dedicated/ga-checklist.md

Asha: Ops item: can we get an emergency runbook for fallback to hosted models? A dozen customers asked about graceful degradation.

Diego: I'll draft a runbook template. ACTION: Diego -> PR runbook into /runbooks/fallback.md and assign reviewers.

Sam: People-ops follow-up: All-hands feedback form closes tomorrow. If you haven't filled it out, please do — we used feedback to prioritize the Q&A topics.

Maya: Perfect. If no objections, I'll mark owners as listed and we'll convert these into a kanban board for tracking.

Chris: +1

Lin: +1

Asha: +1

Diego: +1

ops-bot: Created kanban board: https://redwood.example.com/kanban/ah-followups-1728765432

Maya: Thanks all — if you added items above, please update the board with estimates. Closing the thread for new action owners; reopen if you need to add something after you claim an item. :heart:
